timestamp_assumption: Source timestamps are observation instants. Clock-hour bins are labelled by interval end. Confirm source timezone and interval conventions.
availability_assumption: The hourly interval ending at forecast issue time is available immediately, with no reporting delay.
target: NO2 for the hourly interval ending HORIZON_HOURS after issue time
scaling: StandardScaler fitted on training data only
evaluation: Designed for sequential forecasts updated with newly observed measurements. Not fixed-origin multi-step forecasting.
